citation.title: Effect of acute supplementation of Panax ginseng on endurance running in a hot and humid environment

reported.what: placebo trial plasma lactate, glucose, insulin and free fatty acid, mean ± SD, n=9, at 0, 20, 40, 60 min of treadmill running at 70% VO2max in 31 C and 70% relative humidity and at exhaustion (84 min); the 0-min values follow a 10 h fast, then bread and 500 ml water 2 h before and a placebo capsule 1 h before

location.where: Table III, placebo (Pl) rows, 0 min column

reported.what: placebo trial free fatty acid at 0 min

location.where: Table III, placebo (Pl) rows, 0 min column

reported.what: bout intensity: measured oxygen uptake during the placebo trial (mL/kg/min, mean ± SD), so the bout level could be written

location.where: Table II, VO2 placebo row, 10 min column

detail: The meal 2 h before every sample is 'a piece of bread' with no grams (and the placebo capsule is not described), so not even the 0-min values can be written as a fasted or fed arm; the exercise samples additionally need a 31 C, 70% humidity heat exposure (core temperature 39.2 C at exhaustion), which the model has no input for.
